text.description_html:
Laurey 52466, Transitional Newport Cabinet Cup Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The Oil Rubbed Bronze Newport Cabinet Cup Pull was designed with function and style in mind. This transitional style cabinet bin pull has a rich, Oil Rubbed Bronze finish. The Laurey 52466 3 Inch Pull Newport in Oil Rubbed Bronze comes packaged with the mounting hardware. The use of the Newport Cup Pull on your cabinets will be sure to transform your space into a home.

This transitional cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Newport Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52466 3 Inch Pull Newport Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1.25"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
